blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A government-run kitchen that will provide free meals to people experiencing involuntary hunger in Eastern Visayas is set to open in Catbalogan City, Samar, in the first week of October, the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) said. DSWD Eastern Visayas Regional Director Grace Subong said the “Walang Gutom Kitchen” will initially serve about 200 people daily, providing immediate food assistance and connecting beneficiaries with other government social services. “This is a facility for people who are low-income, those who are living in the streets, and those who have experienced involuntary hunger,” Subong said in an interview […]...
